name: Nebraska Medicine Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteers greet and guide patients and visitors. They help hospital departments. The work is office projects and errands. In some specialty care areas they offer comfort and company to patients.
who_can_apply: Anyone 16 or older who can commit to six months and 2 to 4 hours a week and finish orientation.
duration: Initial six-month commitment, 2 to 4 hours a week
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Apply online any time.
how_to_apply: Submit the online volunteer application. Volunteer Services reviews it. They call you for a welcome meeting. You talk about what you like and when you can come. Then finish New Volunteer Orientation and onboarding.
notes: Quote from the page: Be at least 16 years old.
